usps.title: PMO Safety Radar
usps.painSolved: Unsafe projects are detected too late.
usps.concreteBenefit: Ranks projects by safety level and management attention before status staging.
usps.technicalMechanism: Aggregates Project Safety Gates, PMO Control Tower signals, evidence codes, and management-attention routing.
usps.mvpImplementation: Expose the safety summary and top findings in the maximum USP layer.

proofMetric.name: critical_or_unsafe_projects_identified
proofMetric.target: All unsafe/critical projects visible before PMO review

usps.title: Executive No-Surprise Brief
usps.painSolved: Executives receive escalations too late.
usps.concreteBenefit: Surfaces likely escalations, silent risks, and overdue decisions.
usps.technicalMechanism: Combines No-Surprise Forecast, Decision SLA Cockpit, Safety Gates, and escalation readiness.
usps.mvpImplementation: Use forecast and decision-debt summaries as executive exception source.

proofMetric.name: likely_escalations_detected
proofMetric.target: No likely escalation hidden from executive brief

usps.title: Status Truth Audit
usps.painSolved: Greenwashing and contradictory narratives are hard to detect.
usps.concreteBenefit: Flags KPI/text/progress/finish contradictions and risky kv usage.
usps.technicalMechanism: Runs status delta detection, project truth scores, and status-truth safety gates.
usps.mvpImplementation: Expose low-trust projects, kv_blocked count, and contradiction evidence.

proofMetric.name: non_trusted_statuses
proofMetric.target: All non-trusted statuses visible to PMO

usps.title: Monthly Writeback Guard
usps.painSolved: Monthly status updates are slow and CRM saves are risky.
usps.concreteBenefit: Creates monthly writeback plans while keeping CRM saves confirmation-gated.
usps.technicalMechanism: Uses duplicate checks, idempotency keys, project-manager verification, safety gates, and confirmation text.
usps.mvpImplementation: Use monthly status plans with writeback safety gates.

usps.title: Decision Debt Ledger
usps.painSolved: Open decisions age silently.
usps.concreteBenefit: Shows open, due-today, overdue, and blocked-project decisions with debt score.
usps.technicalMechanism: Uses Decision Closure Items, Decision SLA Cockpit, and decision-debt scoring.

usps.title: Evidence-Backed PMO Reports
usps.painSolved: Reports hide missing source data.
usps.concreteBenefit: Every report carries evidence and data gaps.
usps.technicalMechanism: Uniform PMO report envelopes with evidence, dataGaps, filters, sections, rows, DOCX, and XLSX outputs.
usps.mvpImplementation: Use buildPmoReportSuite and surface total data gaps.

proofMetric.name: report_data_gaps_visible
proofMetric.target: All missing optional fields listed as data gaps

usps.title: Dependency Blast Radius
usps.painSolved: Shared blockers are invisible across projects.
usps.concreteBenefit: Identifies shared dependencies with active risk and affected projects.
usps.technicalMechanism: Groups cross-project dependencies and combines them with blocked/risk signals.

proofMetric.name: shared_dependency_risks
proofMetric.target: Every shared dependency risk lists affected projects

usps.title: Project Manager Readiness Score
usps.painSolved: Weak status quality is not aggregated by owner.
usps.concreteBenefit: Shows which project managers need status-quality coaching.
usps.technicalMechanism: Aggregates status-quality severity, blocked kv, and recommended interventions by project owner.

proofMetric.name: owners_needing_intervention
proofMetric.target: All owners needing PMO coaching listed

usps.title: CIO/CFO Risk Split
usps.painSolved: Different risk types are routed to the wrong owner.
usps.concreteBenefit: Separates management attention and financial/resource exposure.
usps.technicalMechanism: Combines management-attention classification, budget reports, and resource/dependency safety gates.
usps.mvpImplementation: Expose attention counts and budget-risk rows.

usps.title: Audit-Safe AI Recommendation
usps.painSolved: AI recommendations are hard to audit.
usps.concreteBenefit: Backs each recommendation with trust contract, evidence count, missing fields, and human-review flag.
usps.technicalMechanism: Uses Trust Contracts, AI Escalation Packs, evidence sources, and review-only controls.

proofMetric.name: trust_contracts_created
proofMetric.target: One trust contract per reviewed project

usps.title: Portfolio Work Queue
usps.painSolved: PMO teams need action lists, not static reports.
usps.concreteBenefit: Turns findings into a work queue for PMO review, coaching, escalation, and follow-up.
usps.technicalMechanism: Combines PMO Control Tower interventions, project nudges, and the pmo_work_queue report.
usps.mvpImplementation: Expose work queue count and next-action rows.

proofMetric.name: pmo_work_items
proofMetric.target: Every PMO intervention has a next action

usps.title: CRM Writeback Simulation
usps.targetUser: Project leader and CRM process owner
usps.painSolved: Users cannot see writeback blockers before staging.
usps.concreteBenefit: Simulates target fields, blockers, confirmations, and audit preview before any save.
usps.technicalMechanism: Uses safe writeback simulations, create-plan blockers, audit preview, and canAutoSave false.
usps.mvpImplementation: Expose simulation blockers and audit previews.

proofMetric.name: blocked_writeback_simulations
proofMetric.target: Every unsafe writeback blocked before save

sections.title: Generation logic
sections.text: Creates review-only status suggestions from D365 project fields, planning dates, KPI, progress, risks, decisions, sponsor actions, and safety gates.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Suggestions are advisory only. Missing planning or evidence fields are reported as data gaps; CRM writeback remains confirmation-gated.

rows.name: ERP Cutover
rows.proposedStatusText: Das Projekt befindet sich in einem kritischen Zustand. Wesentliche Risiken oder Blocker gefaehrden Termin, Umfang oder Nutzen. Aktueller Risikohinweis: Vendor delivery blocked. Benoetigte Entscheidung: Approve fallback interface. Naechster Schritt ist die kurzfristige Eskalation mit klarer Entscheidung zu Prioritaet, Ressourcen oder Scope.

rows.name: CRM Rollout
rows.proposedStatusText: Status unveraendert seit letztem Bericht. Es gab keine wesentlichen Aenderungen bei Fortschritt, Risiken oder Terminen. Die naechsten geplanten Aktivitaeten werden gemaess bestehender Planung fortgefuehrt.
